This was a great victory this week. House Republicans moved to stop chemical company liability by giving them an immunity shield. 

The people fought back and the language got stripped. 

I will continue to lead and fight in The Senate against the corporations and their lobbyists that want to prevent people from having the legal ability to fight the companies that poison us.

OP: @thefoodbabe

This is sad and unacceptable for people who want to serve on our judiciary

The Trump administration is again trying to silence voices it disagrees with. Jimmy Kimmel and others should not be subject to the whims of this, or any, president.

Video

The Supreme Court’s recent decision means the stakes of this election have risen. It has to be a movement election to protect our democratic rights.

Video

"Having a kind heart in a cruel world is not a weakness, it is a superpower."

Video

This is the power of seeing potential instead of disruption. 
We need to celebrate our kids' imaginations and lift up their dreams. 
Credit: @andyyjiang_

Video

Instead of wasting millions in taxpayer dollars on politically motivated prosecutions against Trump's enemies, the Justice Department should focus on keeping Americans safe.

This is more of President Trump's chaos, cruelty and rising costs for Americans.

Video

$25 billion of American taxpayer dollars—and counting—have been spent on conflict with Iran. 

This isn't just numbers on a ledger. It's our children's futures, our infrastructure, our ability to lift up the vulnerable. 

We need to end this war and start spending our money here at home. 

Credit: @phillydefranco

Video

The Supreme Court's decision is a brutal blow to our highest ideals of our democracy: fair elections and fair representation. 

This is a movement moment. In generations past, when equal representation was eviscerated across the south. A movement rose up to end the anti-democratic, vote suppressing, illegitimate maps and tactics. 

This is what we need to do now. 

Op: @jesscraven101

Video

When Black representation was eviscerated in our past, we needed a movement to restore fairness. Since the Voting Rights Act, Black Americans have begun to have a voice in Congress.

I am standing here as a result of that movement – just the fourth Black American elected to the Senate in U.S. history.

Now we are in a moral moment again, and we need a movement again in this election to ensure every Americans’ voice is heard.

Video

Trump’s reckless war in Iran is driving up prices and endangering American lives while Republicans sit on their hands.

Together with my colleagues, I’m forcing weekly Senate votes and debates to make them confront the costs of this conflict.

I will keep fighting to stop this reckless war and demand real accountability.

Video

This is outrageous and an assault on free and fair elections.

OP: @aaronparnas

Video

Maya Angelou’s words still light the way. 

OP: @natblacktheatre

Video

This is who we are at our best. No one left behind. Neighbors looking out for neighbors.

Video

New Jersey is so proud of Jamie Ding for his historic run on Jeopardy!

Thank you for showing that in Jersey we use our voice to speak up for our friends and neighbors.


Variety (@Variety)

#Jeopardy champion Jamie Ding slams ICE after his 31-day winning streak ends and says "I hope that immigrants can be seen in a positive light" under Trump's federal government.

Yet another blatant example of Trump family corruption.

While Donald Trump sits in the White House, his  son just secured a $24 million Department of Defense contract from his own father’s administration.

Video

Trump’s war in Iran was a reckless blunder that should have surprised no one.

A closed Strait of Hormuz. Rising costs. Billions on the taxpayer’s tab—while he runs this war on a credit card our grandchildren will be paying off for years.

Video

The Supreme Court just made it harder to challenge legislative maps drawn to dilute the voting power of Black and Latino voters.

This is a green light for unconstitutional attacks on the voting rights generations of Americans bled and died to secure.

We will fight back in Congress, in the courts, and at the ballot box.
